---
title: "Combined VAE + UMAP Boxplots by APOE Genotype"
---

## Overview

Combine selected VAE and UMAP dimensions into single faceted boxplots for both thresholds, showing differences across APOE genotypes and risk roles.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(rstatix, colorspace, install = FALSE)

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Load APOE genotype

Load APOE genotype data (shared across both thresholds).

```{r}
apoe_geno <-
  haven::read_sas(here("data/private/apoe_genotype.sas7bdat")) |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(genoapoe = factor(genoapoe, levels = c("22", "23", "33", "44", "34", "24")))
```

## Boxplot functions

Adapted versions that use generic `dim_name`/`dim_value` columns to accommodate mixed VAE + UMAP dimensions.

### By genotype

```{r}
#| output: false

boxplot_colored_box <- function(data_for_boxplot, test_diff, dims, nrow = NULL) {
  color_palette <- colorspace::qualitative_hcl(3, palette = "dark2")

  plot_data <-
    data_for_boxplot |>
    filter(dim_name %in% dims) |>
    mutate(dim_name = factor(dim_name, levels = dims))

  test_data <-
    test_diff |>
    filter(dim_name %in% dims) |>
    mutate(dim_name = factor(dim_name, levels = dims))

  plain_boxplot <-
    plot_data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = genoapoe, y = dim_value)) +
    geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, notch = FALSE) +
    geom_text(
      data = test_data,
      aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
      size = 7, size.unit = "pt", hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3,
      color = "darkred", parse = TRUE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~dim_name, scales = "free_y", nrow = nrow) +
    labs(x = "APOE Genotype", y = "Dimension Value")

  color_box_y <- c(0.01, 0.08)
  label_vjust <- -0.5

  colored_boxplot <-
    plain_boxplot +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = 2.5, ymin = I(color_box_y[1]), ymax = I(color_box_y[2]), fill = color_palette[1], alpha = 1) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 2.5, xmax = 3.5, ymin = I(color_box_y[1]), ymax = I(color_box_y[2]), fill = color_palette[2], alpha = 1) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 3.5, xmax = 6.5, ymin = I(color_box_y[1]), ymax = I(color_box_y[2]), fill = color_palette[3], alpha = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = I(color_box_y[1]), label = "Pro", vjust = label_vjust, size = 6, size.unit = "pt") +
    annotate("text", x = 3, y = I(color_box_y[1]), label = "Neu", vjust = label_vjust, size = 6, size.unit = "pt") +
    annotate("text", x = 5, y = I(color_box_y[1]), label = "Det", vjust = label_vjust, size = 6, size.unit = "pt") +
    geom_text(
      aes(x = genoapoe, y = stage(dim_value, after_stat = middle), label = round(after_stat(middle), 2)),
      color = "#FF7F2A", size = 7, size.unit = "pt", angle = 90,
      stat = "boxplot", vjust = "middle", hjust = -0.3
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

  return(colored_boxplot)
}
```

### By role

```{r}
#| output: false

boxplot_by_role <- function(data_for_boxplot, test_diff, dims, nrow = NULL) {
  color_palette <- colorspace::qualitative_hcl(3, palette = "dark2")

  plot_data <-
    data_for_boxplot |>
    filter(dim_name %in% dims) |>
    mutate(dim_name = factor(dim_name, levels = dims))

  test_data <-
    test_diff |>
    filter(dim_name %in% dims) |>
    mutate(dim_name = factor(dim_name, levels = dims))

  plot_data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = apoe_role, y = dim_value)) +
    geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, notch = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
    geom_text(
      data = test_data,
      aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
      size = 7, size.unit = "pt", hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3,
      color = "darkred", parse = TRUE, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(x = apoe_role, y = stage(dim_value, after_stat = middle),
          label = round(after_stat(middle), 2)),
      color = "#FF7F2A", size = 7, size.unit = "pt", angle = 90,
      stat = "boxplot", vjust = "middle", hjust = -0.3
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~dim_name, scales = "free_y", nrow = nrow) +
    labs(x = "APOE Role", y = "Dimension Value") +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
}
```

## Threshold 8

### Load and prepare data

Load UMAP and VAE embeddings for threshold 8, join APOE genotype, pivot to long format with unified column names, and bind rows.

```{r}
umap_embed_8 <- read_rds(here("UMAP/lite/output/embedding_threshold_8.rds"))
vae_embed_8 <- read_rds(here("VAE/lite/output/embedding_threshold_8.rds"))

dims_thr8 <- c("umap_5", "umap_1", "umap_2", "vae_6", "vae_2", "vae_4")

umap_long_8 <-
  umap_embed_8 |>
  left_join(apoe_geno, by = c("subject_id" = "subr_id18")) |>
  filter(!is.na(genoapoe)) |>
  select(subject_id, genoapoe, starts_with("umap_")) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("umap_"), names_to = "dim_name", values_to = "dim_value")

vae_long_8 <-
  vae_embed_8 |>
  left_join(apoe_geno, by = c("subject_id" = "subr_id18")) |>
  filter(!is.na(genoapoe)) |>
  select(subject_id, genoapoe, starts_with("vae_")) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("vae_"), names_to = "dim_name", values_to = "dim_value")

data_thr8 <-
  bind_rows(umap_long_8, vae_long_8) |>
  mutate(genoapoe = factor(genoapoe, levels = c("22", "23", "33", "24", "34", "44"))) |>
  mutate(apoe_role = case_when(
    genoapoe %in% c("22", "23") ~ "Protective",
    genoapoe == "33" ~ "Neutral",
    genoapoe %in% c("24", "34", "44") ~ "Detrimental"
  )) |>
  mutate(apoe_role = factor(apoe_role, levels = c("Protective", "Neutral", "Detrimental")))

glimpse(data_thr8)
```

### Kruskal-Wallis test by role

```{r}
kruskal_thr8 <-
  data_thr8 |>
  filter(dim_name %in% dims_thr8) |>
  group_by(dim_name) |>
  rstatix::kruskal_test(dim_value ~ apoe_role) |>
  mutate(label = glue("italic(P) == {round(p, 5)}"))

kruskal_thr8
```

### Boxplot by genotype

```{r}
#| label: fig-thr8-genotype
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

p_geno_thr8 <- boxplot_colored_box(data_thr8, kruskal_thr8, dims_thr8, nrow = 2)

p_geno_thr8
```

### Boxplot by role

```{r}
#| label: fig-thr8-role
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

p_role_thr8 <- boxplot_by_role(data_thr8, kruskal_thr8, dims_thr8, nrow = 2)

p_role_thr8
```

## Threshold 7

### Load and prepare data

Load UMAP and VAE embeddings for threshold 7, same preparation as threshold 8.

```{r}
umap_embed_7 <- read_rds(here("UMAP/lite/output/embedding_threshold_7.rds"))
vae_embed_7 <- read_rds(here("VAE/lite/output/embedding_threshold_7.rds"))

dims_thr7 <- c("umap_2", "umap_1", "umap_3", "vae_1", "vae_2")

umap_long_7 <-
  umap_embed_7 |>
  left_join(apoe_geno, by = c("subject_id" = "subr_id18")) |>
  filter(!is.na(genoapoe)) |>
  select(subject_id, genoapoe, starts_with("umap_")) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("umap_"), names_to = "dim_name", values_to = "dim_value")

vae_long_7 <-
  vae_embed_7 |>
  left_join(apoe_geno, by = c("subject_id" = "subr_id18")) |>
  filter(!is.na(genoapoe)) |>
  select(subject_id, genoapoe, starts_with("vae_")) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("vae_"), names_to = "dim_name", values_to = "dim_value")

data_thr7 <-
  bind_rows(umap_long_7, vae_long_7) |>
  mutate(apoe_role = case_when(
    genoapoe %in% c("22", "23") ~ "Protective",
    genoapoe == "33" ~ "Neutral",
    genoapoe %in% c("24", "34", "44") ~ "Detrimental"
  )) |>
  mutate(apoe_role = factor(apoe_role, levels = c("Protective", "Neutral", "Detrimental")))

glimpse(data_thr7)
```

### Kruskal-Wallis test by role

```{r}
kruskal_thr7 <-
  data_thr7 |>

  group_by(dim_name) |>
  rstatix::kruskal_test(dim_value ~ apoe_role) |>

kruskal_thr7
```

### Boxplot by genotype

```{r}
#| label: fig-thr7-genotype
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 5

p_geno_thr7 <- boxplot_colored_box(data_thr7, kruskal_thr7, dims_thr7, nrow = 1)
```

### Boxplot by role

```{r}

```

## Save the boxplots

Save all combined boxplots as both RDS and PNG files.

```{r}
fs::dir_create(here("APOE/output"))

# Threshold 8
write_rds(p_geno_thr8, here("APOE/output/apoe_boxplot_thr8_combined.rds"))
ggsave(here("APOE/output/apoe_boxplot_thr8_combined.png"),
       p_geno_thr8, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300, device = grDevices::png)

write_rds(p_role_thr8, here("APOE/output/apoe_role_boxplot_thr8_combined.rds"))
ggsave(here("APOE/output/apoe_role_boxplot_thr8_combined.png"),
       p_role_thr8, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300, device = grDevices::png)

# Threshold 7
write_rds(p_geno_thr7, here("APOE/output/apoe_boxplot_thr7_combined.rds"))
ggsave(here("APOE/output/apoe_boxplot_thr7_combined.png"),
       p_geno_thr7, width = 20, height = 5, dpi = 300, device = grDevices::png)

write_rds(p_role_thr7, here("APOE/output/apoe_role_boxplot_thr7_combined.rds"))
ggsave(here("APOE/output/apoe_role_boxplot_thr7_combined.png"),
       p_role_thr7, width = 20, height = 5, dpi = 300, device = grDevices::png)
```
